signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Try Contentor free for 14 days. Your site is ready in about 15 minutes.
signup.brandNameLabel: Studio or business name (or just your name)
signup.brandStepHeading: What's your studio or business called?
signup.brandStepSubhead: This is the name your students will see. You can change it later.
signup.addressPreview: Your site: {address}. The name can change later; this address can't.
signup.nameKeep: Pick one, or press Continue to keep your name as it is.
signup.nameKeepAuth: Pick one, or press Create platform to keep your name as it is.
signup.ideasFailed: Couldn't get ideas right now. Try again in a moment.
signup.aboutStepSubhead: Share a bio, CV, or notes about what you teach. We'll use it to pre-fill your site and course details.
signup.aboutFileHint: Up to 5 MB. Documents are only used to build your platform.
signup.aboutOrPaste: Or paste your bio or notes here:

signup.aboutGeneralNote: Information saved. We'll use your background to guide your platform setup.
signup.aboutEmptyWarning: Please write a few notes or choose a file to add.
signup.contactStepHeading: Where should we send your link?
signup.contactStepSubhead: We'll email you a link to verify and start building.
signup.verifyDescription: We sent a link to {email}. Click it and you go straight to building your site: a few questions about what you teach, and your site takes shape while you answer.
signup.spamHint: Can't find it? Check your spam folder.

resume.title: Your setup link expired
